name: strata
description: Strata — 4D Reality Intelligence Platform: a persistent spatial memory of a physical environment.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @strata/server && npm run build -w @strata/simulator && npm run build -w @strata/adapters && npm run build -w @strata/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p packages/simulator && tsc -p packages/adapters && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web
